query:
UPDATE code_runs
           SET status = CASE WHEN $3::text IS NOT NULL THEN $3 WHEN $2 = 'failed' THEN 'internal_error' ELSE $2 END,
               verdict = $3, passed = $4, score = $5::float8, compile_output = $6,
               error_message = $7, finished_at = now()
           WHERE id = $1
